data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-2: Sub-agent handoff documentation describes receipt-only return contract and RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR escalation semantics
- dd-3: DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION block present in completion report; any CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE reports surfaced to user

## Description
Apply plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/doc-router.md gates. Default target: plugins/dso/docs/SUB-AGENT-BOUNDARIES.md (or whichever sub-agent-handoff doc exists per gate 2 — extends existing reference doc). Document:
- Receipt-only return contract: sub-agents writing handoff payloads to `dso ticket scratch set` and returning ONLY `<output_contract>` with SCRATCH_TICKET_ID + SCRATCH_KEY identifiers (no embedded payload).
- RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR semantics: orchestrator parses receipt via plugins/dso/scripts/receipt-parse.sh; malformed return blocks emit structured log `event=RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR site_id=<id> sub_agent=<name> reason=<text> byte_count=<int>` and halt workflow (no silent retry/forward, surface to human).
- Cross-link to plugins/dso/docs/contracts/scratch-receipt-contract.md.
- CLAUDE.md edits: emit CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report ONLY — do not edit CLAUDE.md directly. If a session-level rule about receipt-only contract is warranted, surface as report.
- Completion report must include DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION block naming the gate that fired and the resolved target.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh exits 0
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Sub-agent handoff doc updated with receipt-only contract
  Verify: grep -lE 'receipt-only|RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR' plugins/dso/docs/SUB-AGENT-BOUNDARIES.md plugins/dso/docs/*.md
- [ ] Cross-link to scratch-receipt-contract.md present
  Verify: grep -rq 'scratch-receipt-contract.md' plugins/dso/docs/
- [ ] DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION in completion report
  Verify: (sub-agent completion report contains DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION block — orchestrator validates at task closure)

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
|---|---|
| plugins/dso/docs/SUB-AGENT-BOUNDARIES.md (or equivalent per doc-router) | Edit |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 sonnet → opus → user.
data.title: Update sub-agent handoff docs with receipt-only contract semantics
